Language Courses

More languages, the same practical approach

The teaching method that works for German — small groups, real conversation, clear structure — applied to the other languages our students ask for most.

Why Add a Language Here

One school, one consistent standard

Many of our students are already learning German with us and want to keep a language skill sharp, prepare for relocation, or support a partner or child. Our other language courses follow the same small-group, conversation-first model — just with a different target language.

  • Small groups capped at 10 students
  • Teachers who are native or near-native speakers
  • Flexible evening, weekend, and online formats
  • Materials included in every course fee

Interested in a language beyond German?

Tell us your goals and timeline, and we'll recommend the right course and schedule.
